evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド

text.jp:
それにしても、受付に来た子供が、まさか
アウロラ様の御子様だったなんて……
text.official_en:
I still can't believe that Aurora's son showed up out
of nowhere to register for the games...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
最初は何かの冗談だとばかり思ったけど……
なんだか、人と人の出会いって不思議ね。
text.official_en:
I thought it was a joke. It's so strange how people can
meet each other, isn't it?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あ、アウロラ様には、まだ御子様が大剣闘祭に
参加することは内緒にしているの。
text.official_en:
I mean, I'm still keeping it a secret from Aurora that
you're participating in the Heroic Games.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
わたしも、どこかでちゃんとご説明して
差し上げないとって思っているのだけど……
text.official_en:
I'll have to explain it to her sometime...
Just not now.

text.official_en: <TH>

準備は万端かしら？
text.official_en: Your match is today. Are you ready to fight?

text.jp:
あ、カイくん！
どう？　ダグシオンにはもう慣れたの？
text.official_en:
Cai! How are you? Have you gotten used to life in
Dagsion yet?
text.real_en:
Kai-kun! How are you? Have you gotten used to life in
Dagsion yet?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
お願いだから、
くれぐれも危ないことはしないでね。
text.official_en:
I just ask that you don't get involved in anything
dangerous, OK?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
え……！？
牢屋でカストールに会えたの？
text.official_en: What?! You met with Castor in his cell?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そんな……どうやって？
だって、あそこは関係者しか入れない筈じゃ……
text.official_en:
How did you manage that? I thought only officials
were allowed in there.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
なにか悪い事をしているんじゃないわよね？
そんな事をして本当に大丈夫なの？
text.official_en:
Are you sure you're supposed to be down there?
You aren't doing anything wrong, I hope.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
わたくし、心配だわ……もしもカイくんまで
捕まっちゃうような事があったら……
text.official_en: I do so worry that you might get in trouble.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……それはさすがに
わたくしが心配し過ぎなのかしら。
text.official_en:
Listen to me. I've fallen into my old habit of
worrying too much.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
特別試合に参加していたからといって、
白髪鬼が大剣闘祭に出るとは限らないわ。
text.official_en:
The White-Maned Demon fought a special match,
but it doesn't mean he'll appear in the Heroic Games.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だから……多分、あの人と戦うような
ことにはならないと思うんだけど……
text.official_en:
I'm simply saying we won't necessarily have to
fight him.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
はあー……うん、ぼくはいま、大剣闘祭の
試合の水準を思い出して絶望してるところ。
text.official_en:
*sigh* Every time I think about the Heroic Games,
I get more worried.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
本当に大丈夫かなあ……
やっぱり心配だなあ、すごく……
text.official_en: Are we going to be OK? Are we really?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
大剣闘祭みたいな大きなお祭りに
参加するなんて、わくわくしちゃう。
text.official_en:
It's so exciting to be taking part in something as big
as the Heroic Games.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
予選試合まであまり日はないけど、
しっかりと準備しておかなくちゃ。
text.official_en:
There aren't many days between now and the
qualifiers. We need to get prepared.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
もうすぐ、予選試合かあ……
ううう……嫌だなあ、不安だなあ……
text.official_en:
It's almost time for the qualifiers. Urgh... I hate being
so anxious.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
試合までに自信がつくいい方法でも
あるといいんだけど、何か知らない……？
text.official_en:
There's got to be some way I could get my confidence
up before the match. Probably? I hope?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なんだよ、また来たのか？
そんな暇があるなら、訓練でもしとけ。
text.official_en:
You're here again? If you've got so much free time,
you ought to be training.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
武器は毎日欠かさず触っとけ。いざという時、
それが分かれ目になることもあるんだからな。
text.official_en:
Take your weapon in hand, every day, without fail.
Training regularly can make all the difference.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
御子様、
街にはもう慣れましたかな？
text.official_en:
Have you had the opportunity to become acquainted
with the city?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この帝都ダグシオンは、建造から１４００年
近くを数える、実に歴史ある都市です。
text.official_en:
It's been close to 14 hundred years since construction
began on Dagsion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
滞在されている間に色々な場所を回り、
見識を得るとよいでしょう。
text.official_en:
Explore the city during your stay. There's much to
learn here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ですが……厄介な者もいるようです。
くれぐれもご用心くださいますよう。
text.official_en:
But stay wary. There are troublesome folk about,
so I ask that you take the utmost care.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ついに大剣闘祭が始まったが、
優勝するのは果たしてどのクランか……
text.official_en:
The Heroic Games are underway at last! Who do you
think will win?

text.jp:
やっぱり、サラミスの女王が
最有力の優勝候補ってとこだろうな。
text.official_en:
I still say the queen of Saramis is the most likely to
win the whole contest.
